rationale.A: Töölönlahti paths but 150 m in traffic on tram-railed Aleksis Kiven katu + 100 m Helsinginkatu, two unsignalised arterial crossings
rationale.B: Same as A but starts on tram-railed Viipurinkatu (30 km/h) instead; one unsignalised crossing
rationale.C: No traffic at all: paths via Töölönlahti and Baana; only ~0.9 km beside arterials; +1 min
rationale.D: Linnunlaulu and Töölönlahti paths, 1 light, but 180 m in traffic on tram-railed Viipurinkatu
rationale.E: Car-free via Olympic stadium/opera paths; a bit more beside Mäntymäentie and an extra unsignalised crossing
rationale.F: Car-free through Kaisaniemi park and Kaisantunneli to Baana, least arterial-side riding, 1 light
rationale.G: Through Kallio streets: 230 m on Porvoonkatu with tram rails, arterial-side tracks, 7 lights
rationale.H: Car-free, but its first 0.7 km is a track beside Aleksis Kiven katu; +5 min

notes: C, E and F are all car-free; F is marginally calmest but C gets the calm card because it removes the tier-E stretch for only +1 min. D saves 2 lights for +2 min.
